_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for XOM retrospectives (retro/build_xom.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern; EDGAR gives only the filing date before 2003); the earnings 8-Ks of 2007-2008 were accepted before the open or during the session on their release days (each print's release_time says which). The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print reports the year just ended and extends the history until the 10-K), and the latest declared dividend. ExxonMobil's fiscal year is the calendar year. It gives no earnings, revenue or margin guidance in numbers in any filing of 2007-2012, so the no-guide rules apply; from 2009 the analyst-meeting 8-Ks state the current year's production outlook in numbers, which 'guides' keeps as display only ('production_quote': method r2 has no volume input, the UNP rule). Values are as reported; a vintage takes each year from the latest filing that reports it, per share as published (the 2001 two-for-one split restates the years published before it: 'eps_published', 'shares_published'), and the company's earnings per share excluding special items replace GAAP EPS where a filing publishes them (the history's 'normalization' says which). Revenue is total revenues and other income, the one revenue line the releases publish. A print's growth rates and margin are derived from the raw figures of its release ('raw'; the builder re-derives and checks them): the year-ago quarter is the one the same release shows. rule_t holds the annual values behind the engine's signal thresholds. Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing.
